"Buatkan saya game 3d tentang kereta dan simulasi. Mula mula kita akan ada di menu dan harus pilih new game maksudnya kita buat game baru, continue kita continue game yang kita baru save, setting maksudnya kita bisa ubah graphic dan control. Setelah kita masuk kita ada di rumah kita atau di dalam bilik di rumah kita ada tempat tidur, dapur, tempat mandi. Dan di pojok kiri atas ada health maksudnya kalo kita jatuh atau accident kereta dan lain lain kayak GK makan dan minum, lalu hunger kita harus makan untuk menambahnya balik, lalu thirst untuk minum agar tidak haus, lalu strees kita harus menjaga strees kita boleh mengurangkan strees dari merokok dan minum alkohol, lalu Cleanliness ini bikin orang tidak rasa bau dan respect dengan kita. Lalu jika kita keluar kita ada kereta tapi kita harus memasang benda benda yang hilang kayak tayar dan bateri. Tayarnya ada di rumah rosak yang lumayan jauh dan kita ada satu satunya motosikal agar kita boleh memasang benda bendanya. Lalu ada tempat seperti bengkel kereta yang menjual barang barang kereta atau tempat pembiakan kereta dan tempat kedai runcit yang cukup jauh. Lalu saya lupa satu lagi kita punya duit untuk membeli barang barang yang ada di pojok kiri atas dan juga fatigue untuk tidur, lalu untuk save game kita harus tidur di bilik kita dan nama game ini my spring car

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D car-life simulation game named “My Spring Car” based on the user’s Malay-language concept.

## Requirements
- Main menu with New Game, Continue, and Settings for graphics and controls.
- Home with bed, kitchen, washroom; player stats for health, hunger, thirst, stress, cleanliness, money, and fatigue.
- Explore using a motorcycle, find missing car parts, visit a workshop and grocery shop, maintain needs, and sleep to save.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone Three.js browser game in one `index.html`; UI and gameplay text are mostly English with some Malay wording.
- Save state uses browser `localStorage`; graphics toggle switches pixel ratio, and control sensitivity is represented in settings.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a menu, 3D town/home scene, player movement, HUD, needs management, interactions, shops, vehicle driving, part collection/installing, and sleep/save behavior.
- Added responsive on-screen touch controls alongside keyboard controls.
- JavaScript syntax checked successfully with `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Playwright and captured `/tmp/opencode/my-spring-game.jpg`.

### Active
- Confirm browser gameplay visually and functionally after the latest fix; the most recent screenshot was captured but not inspected after capture.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/my-spring-game.jpg` if visual verification is needed.
2. Test menu interaction, movement, sleeping/saving, and game interactions in the browser; fix any issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- A local dev server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright browser opened at `http://localhost:3002`; earlier the page showed stray script text due to event handlers accidentally placed after `</html>`, which was fixed by moving them before `</script>`.
- The last browser reload and New Game click succeeded; syntax check is clean.
- Changes are uncommitted.
